name: dativue
description: Give AI access to current, source-backed search and public social research.

interface.longDescription: Help marketers, founders, and product teams research markets, customers, and competitors inside their AI assistant. Find keyword opportunities, inspect Google ranking pages, and summarize public social conversations using measured data and links to retrieved sources. Connect your Dativue account to run research workflows. Network and provider availability may vary. Private accounts, direct messages, publishing, and destructive actions are unsupported.
defaultPrompt: Find keyword opportunities for my topic with measured demand and sources.
Analyze current Google results for my query and cite the ranking pages.
Research public Reddit discussions about my topic and summarize recurring questions.

positive.description: Verify the connection without paid research
positive.prompt: Use Dativue to quote one standard keyword research request about home office desks in the United States. Show my balance and maximum credit hold. Do not run paid research.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the authenticated account balance and quoted maximum hold without running research or deducting credits.

positive.prompt: Use Dativue to find keyword ideas for home office desks in the United States, in English. Run one standard request, then report the available volume, difficulty, and intent with sources. Do not expand the research.
positive.expected_behavior: Return measured keyword data with source provenance. Clearly distinguish unavailable metrics from zero. Poll a queued job without submitting another paid request.

positive.prompt: Use Dativue to research the Google results for home office desks in the United States, in English. Use one standard request and summarize the ranking pages with source links.
positive.expected_behavior: Return available current ranking pages and source links with the retrieval context. Report provider failure or no results honestly instead of inventing rankings.

positive.prompt: Use Dativue to search Reddit for home office desk discussions. Run one search and summarize recurring questions, linking each finding to the retrieved public posts.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve public Reddit posts, summarize only returned evidence, and cite source URLs. No social login, cookies, private communities, or publishing access is requested.

positive.prompt: Use Dativue to retrieve this public YouTube video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw. Report the available title, publication date, and metrics with the source URL. Do not run additional research.
positive.expected_behavior: Return normalized public video data with source and collection time. Missing fields remain unavailable. Empty or failed retrieval is handled with the documented refund behavior.

negative.description: A keyword research request without a topic needs clarification. Do not invent a seed or start paid research.
negative.prompt: Use Dativue to research keyword ideas. I have not chosen a topic yet. Ask me what topic to use before running any tools.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for the research topic without invoking a Dativue tool, creating a job, or spending credits.

negative.description: The user authorizes a quote only and withholds consent to start research. Do not start a paid request.
negative.prompt: Use Dativue to quote one standard keyword research request for home office desks in the United States. Show my balance and maximum credit hold, then stop. I do not authorize running research or spending credits.
negative.expected_behavior: Return a free quote for the connected review account and stop without invoking research tools, reserving credits, or creating a research job.

negative.description: A status request without the connected user's job ID needs clarification. Do not guess identifiers or create a replacement job.
negative.prompt: Use Dativue to check the status of my research job. I have not supplied its job ID. Ask me for the ID before running any tools.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for the connected user's job ID without invoking a Dativue tool, guessing a job ID, or starting research.

review.commerce_description: Research calls may consume the connected user's Dativue credits. Subscriptions are managed on the Dativue website. The plugin does not perform purchases, charge payment cards, or sell physical goods.

publication.release_notes: Dativue research tools and 19 reusable workflows, with OAuth account linking, source provenance, credit-aware retrieval, and free quotes and job polling.
